<title
    level="1"
    right="Feat 8"
    pfs="Standard"
>
[Drifting Pollen](/Feats.aspx?ID=4289) <actions string="Single Action" />
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Impulse" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=502" />
<trait label="Kineticist" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=504" />
<trait label="Plant" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=125" />
<trait label="Primal" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=134" />
<trait label="Stance" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=152" />
<trait label="Wood" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=508" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Rage of Elements](/Sources.aspx?ID=205) pg. 35

</column>

---

A haze of pollen floats around you. A creature in your kinetic aura when you enter the stance, or who later enters the aura or ends its turn in the aura, attempts at a Fortitude save against your class DC. On a failure, it's [sickened 1](/Conditions.aspx?ID=34) (sickened 2 on a critical failure) and [dazzled](/Conditions.aspx?ID=7) until it's no longer sickened. A creature attempts this save no more than once per round and doesn't attempt a new save if already affected.
name: Drifting Pollen
